items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

ctx.x: They have little struts and things that you can collapse for easy storage. It reminds me of an exercise machine you throw under your bed, this kind of thing. Bob Cranshaw has a good one though, that he had custom made for him, which is a bass — well it’s a stick but it’s got more of a cavity, like maybe a shoe box or slightly larger size piece of wood that’s hollow. It has some resonance factor to it, so the bridge is not just sitting on a block of wood, it’s something solid. So it moves a little bit. So it…
I don’t know. You’d have to ask him.
